Thanks Marissa - quick clarifications from our side: 

- Deletion SLA: Procurement expects a hard SLA for deletion from live production data (we commonly ask 30 days). We also need clarity on backups: are deleted records removed from backups within the same SLA, or is that a different window (90/180 days)?
- Logs & traces: we collect request/response logs for debugging in our product; we need to know Redwood's default retention for those and whether we can configure shorter windows for a subset of customers.
- Compliance posture: is Redwood SOC 2 Type II current? We also need to understand whether Redwood has a HIPAA BA/controls for handling PHI (Amaya handles some PHI).

If you could share the SOC 2 report (redacted OK) and an explicit statement about backup deletion behavior, that should get us through initial procurement. I'll also start the vendor security questionnaire once you send it.

Hi Jordan / Priya - Neha from Redwood security here. Thanks for the clear questions - answers below and I've attached the redacted SOC 2 Type II for 2026 (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf).

1) SOC 2 / HIPAA
- SOC 2 Type II: current (report period FY2026). Attached is a redacted copy for procurement review.
- HIPAA: Redwood operates under documented security policies and technical controls that support HIPAA compliance; we are willing to execute a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) where customers require it. We do not self-attest as a HIPAA BA by default - we support customer-specific BAAs and have implemented administrative, physical, and technical controls to meet HIPAA requirements.

2) Deletion & backups (explicit)
- Live data deletion: Redwood will remove customer data from production systems within 30 days of an authenticated deletion request by default.
- Backups / snapshots: backups are immutable snapshots retained for 90 days by default. Deleted records are not immediately removed from existing immutable snapshots; however, snapshots that are created after a deletion request will not contain the deleted data. For procurement purposes, we can offer an accelerated purge process: we can prioritize expiring snapshots containing specific datasets and reduce the backup retention for scoped datasets down to 30 days as a contractual option (requires agreement and operational lead time).
- Evidence: we can provide attestations and, where required, hashed proofs of deletion for scoped datasets.

3) Logs & traces
- Default log retention: 90 days.
- Configurable scopes: we can configure shorter retention windows (e.g., 30 days) for specific customers or dataset groups; this is an opt-in configuration that we'll document in the contract.

If you need narrower SLAs (e.g., 30-day removal from backups for all data), we can surface pricing/operational impact and propose contract language. Happy to hop on a follow-up call to walk through options.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf

Best -
